newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Barnevik says staying with Sandvik.
newsitem.headline: Barnevik says staying with Sandvik.

text.p: Swedish industrialist Percy Barnevik said on Monday he had decided to remain chairman of tool maker/engineer Sandvik but not of construction company Skanska.
Barnevik is leaving the Skanska board as he takes up the chairmanship of Investor, the investment arm of the powerful Swedish Wallenberg family.
Skanska does not fall within the extensive Wallenberg business empire but is seen in a rival power sphere.
Barnevik did not say this was the reason he was leaving Skanska. "I also sit on the board of DuPont and General Motors that are not Wallenberg companies," he told a news conference.
"Skanska is different from Sandvik. I have worked at Sandvik for 10 years and know the company inside out.
"I can deal with questions about Sandvik just on the phone but with Skanska it take more time for me."
